title: Chehra Mere Maula ka
body:
Khaliq ne banaya hai chehra mere maula Ka
Imaan ka kaba hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khush binte asad hokar padti hai ruqe haider
Quran bhi padta Hai Chehra Maula mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaabe se nikalte hi khush hoke payambar ne
Aankho se lagaya hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tasbeehe quda padhke aur shukr ada karke
Imran ne chuma hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Deedar e ali karke Jibreele ameen bole
Rahman ka sura hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Wallai ki zulfe hai wa al fajr ke abru hai
Wannoor ka jalwa hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ek baaar hi jo dekhe bas dekhta rehjaye
Qudrat ka karishma hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Karta hai tawaf ab bhi qud surahe yousuf bhi
Vo husn ka quibla hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Alhamd ke sure se Wannaaas ke sure tak
Har lavz me dekha chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Ek baar hi jo dekhe bas dekhta jaye
Qudrat ka karishma hai Chehra Mere Maula kA
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Karta hai tawaf ab bhi qud suraye yousuf bhi
Vo husn ka Quibla hai Chehra Mere Maula Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Har roz mere dil ne pocha yehi suraj se
Kya dekh ke nikla hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Ruqsarr hai noorani wa shams hai peshani
Qulhuwallah ka sura hai chehra mere maula ka
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Kyu kar na mohinb jaye haste huwe duniase
Jab Nazha Me dekha hai Chehra mere maula ka
14 . Shabbir ne shabbar ne kulsoom ne zainab ne
Abbas me dekha hai chehra mere maula ka
15 . Ye Raaz qamar kaise samjhau nusairi ko
Allah ka Chehra Hai chehra mere maula
